violation_type.title: Parental Notification of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation Deficiency (26 TAC §746.309(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Parental Notification of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation Deficiency
violation_type.typical_finding: As related a DFPS investigation you must notify the parents of each child attending that your child-care center has a deficiency related abuse, neglect, or exploitation standard.

finding_variants.text: As related a DFPS investigation you must notify the parents of each child attending that your child-care center has a deficiency related abuse, neglect, or exploitation standard.
The operation has not notified parents of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation Deficiency received at the operation.
